rows.title: Green Room
rows.blurb: Ginger, wet leaves, and garlic frying far below. The stair ends high in a giant tree: a platform with a velvet rope.

rows.title: Jungle Clearing
rows.blurb: Honey, ozone, and wet earth, warm underfoot. You land in a mound of grey-green lichen, soft and deep.

rows.title: Gingerbread Town
rows.blurb: Ginger, burnt sugar, and wet icing.

rows.title: Film Set
rows.blurb: Wet stone, cold river, and frying garlic. Somebody is cooking.

rows.title: Last Set
rows.blurb: Cold, burnt plastic, and the sea. A wrecked studio in a cave.

rows.title: Fern Hollow
rows.blurb: Aviation fuel, wet feathers, and something rotten in the heat. The raptor trail ends at a crashed helicopter, nose down in the ferns, BEST CHEF on its tail.

rows.title: Gingerbread Cottage
rows.blurb: Treacle, hot iron, and old cigarette smoke. The lane ends at a cottage far too perfect: gingerbread walls, icing on the eaves.

rows.title: Kitchen Stadium
rows.blurb: Burnt sugar, hot fat, and sawdust.

rows.title: Cookbook Stacks
rows.blurb: Butter and cold mint. A brass menu in the glass tower lists quality gear and one-shot abilities.

rows.title: Fungus Cave
rows.blurb: Butter, damp earth, and a deep animal stink. Brown mushroom shelves climb the cave walls above beds of yellow puffballs and red cups.

rows.title: Season Reserve
rows.blurb: Cold bites your teeth. Blue lamps shine through four thick glass shutters.

rows.title: Dish Pit
rows.blurb: Hot soap, old gravy, and rain from sweating pipes. Plates rattle down a conveyor into three sinks: SCRAPE, WASH, RINSE.

rows.title: Salt Lick
rows.blurb: Salt dust catches in your throat. White terraces step down to a dripping pipe.

rows.title: Knife-Throwing Tent
rows.blurb: Hot canvas, lamp oil and popcorn. Knives hammer into a revolving dinner plate ten feet across.

rows.title: Comb Gate
rows.blurb: Warm wax and a buzzing you feel in your teeth. The knot hole opens into a hollow trunk, ribbed with comb and glazed amber as high as you can see.

rows.title: Brood Galleries
rows.blurb: Warm milk, yeast, and something sour. A long gallery of six-sided cells, floor to ceiling.

rows.title: Drip Works
rows.blurb: Vinegar and hot metal, sharp enough to make your eyes water. Wax vats as big as bathtubs line the walls, brimming with something clear that smokes where it drips.

rows.title: Inner Comb
rows.blurb: Hot. Sweet enough to make you gag.

rows.title: Canopy Market
rows.blurb: Overripe fruit, cheap wine, and monkey. A hundred feet up, rope bridges sag between trunks as wide as houses.

rows.title: Smokehouse
rows.blurb: Hickory smoke so thick you can chew it, and under it, bacon. A hunting lodge has fallen in on itself.

rows.title: Vine Pit
rows.blurb: Wet leaf mould, sap, and something sweet like a pie left on a sill. A sinkhole drops away under the canopy, choked with strangler vines thick as arms.

rows.title: First Hearth
rows.blurb: Woodsmoke and wet stone under a soot-black overhang. A banked fire; figures in hides stop chewing and watch you like prey.

rows.title: Cave of Safe
rows.blurb: A CREW ONLY door in the quiet bank opens on a fake cave: foam rock, LED mammoths, speaker fire with real heat.

rows.title: Candy Mile
rows.blurb: Burnt sugar, hot mud, and a sweet rot. Hard-candy cobbles climb through the ferns, slick and half sunk.

rows.title: Back Stile
rows.blurb: Sugar, mushroom, and warm canvas. A low gap in the back wall, behind the cottages.

rows.title: Bleacher Tunnel
rows.blurb: Sawdust, hot canvas, and a fryer somewhere above. A cinderblock tunnel under the seats.

rows.title: Fitting Room
rows.blurb: Hairspray, hot cloth, and leather warmed under a bulb. A narrow room off the tunnel.
